caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object resembles a dark-colored, likely black, cylindrical vessel with a slightly flared rim at the top. The surface of the vessel is glossy and reflects light, creating highlights and giving the impression of a smooth, shiny texture. On the side of the vessel, there is a detailed painted floral decoration consisting of green leaves and small white bell-shaped flowers with green stems and some tiny lavender-blue and pink flowers. The vessel is unusual in that it stands on two human-like bare feet, which are fleshy in color with visible toes and toenails, positioned at the base of the vessel. The drawing is signed "E. Trenschin, Jr." near the lower right of the vessel.
title: Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
